name: Arcane Focus
description:
Magic is something external to you, which you have learned to bend to your will through the use of a special tool: your arcane focus. Without it, you are unable to cast Arcanist spells.

Your Arcanist archetype (Hedge Mage, Rune Knight, or Wizard of the Tower) determines what type of arcane focus you use. Rune Knights turn their equipment into arcane focuses regularly with runes, but Hedge Mages and Wizards of the Tower must obtain a pre-enchanted arcane focus, which generally requires attunement. You may only be attuned to one arcane focus at a time.

Describe your arcane focus.
